sloka: कुम्भकर्णस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धः समारूढः प्लवङ्गमैः।व्यधूनयत्तान् वेगेन दुष्टहस्तीव हस्तिपान् ।। ६.६७.१२० ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇastu saṅkruddhaḥ samārūḍhaḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ।vyadhūnayattān vegena duṣṭahastīva hastipān ।। 6.67.120 ।।

translations.english: Pierced by Rama's missiles, the foremost of the Rakshasas, Kumbhakarna was very angry and rushed towards him dispersing all the vanaras in the battle.
